metadata.name: hybrid_vault
metadata.description: Track A (SPL-404) token<->NFT vault: VRF-selected blind capture/re-roll, exact unwrap, fixed 2% fee to an immutable fee account. Bound 1:1 to a hybrid_launch LaunchConfig. Devnet/localnet only. NOT AUDITED.

fields.name: sb_queue
docs: Switchboard On-Demand queue every randomness account must use.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: Immutable launch record for one Track A mint. PDA `["launch_config", mint]`.
There is NO instruction that modifies or closes this account: ratio,
collection size, SOL fees, fee recipient and mint are fixed at launch
(Stonk.fun lesson: no mutable economics after launch).

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the launch. Holds no powers.

fields.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL Token mint; mint + freeze authority are `None`.

fields.name: launch_destination
docs: ATA(launch_vault, mint): received the full supply. Owned by the PDA below;
no instruction can move tokens out of it (distribution mechanism TBD).

fields.name: launch_vault
docs: PDA `["launch_vault", mint, launch_config]` owning `launch_destination`.

fields.name: ratio_whole_tokens
docs: Whole tokens per NFT (one of ALLOWED_RATIOS).

fields.name: ratio_base
docs: ratio_whole_tokens * 10^decimals.

fields.name: collection_size
docs: Number of NFTs in the collection.

fields.name: max_tokens_in_nft_form
docs: collection_size * ratio_base (<= total_supply_base).

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: The flat SOL fee (lamports) charged on EVERY capture, release and re-roll, fixed forever
(ADR-013) = fee_for_ratio(ratio_whole_tokens) at launch; <= MAX_FEE_LAMPORTS (0.01 SOL).
There is no token fee.

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: PLATFORM_FEE_RECIPIENT at launch time: the only address any fee can reach (F-06 / M-05).

fields.name: graduation_threshold_lamports
docs: Graduation threshold (lamports raised; DBC migration threshold). `graduation_slice_pct` is
always 0 since lazy minting (ADR-016); the field stays for the append-only layout.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: DBC config of the curve (`register_dbc_launch`); default for native `launch` (never opens).

fields.name: dbc_pool
docs: DBC virtual pool of the curve. `hybrid_vault::graduation::verify` only accepts this pool, and
only once DBC reports it migrated. Default for native `launch` => the vault can never open.

types.name: LeafPreimage
docs: Leaf preimage supplied by the settler for a lazy mint (graduation-design §5.1).

fields.name: uri
docs: Content-addressed URI of the metadata JSON; becomes the asset's on-chain URI verbatim.

types.name: MintArgs
docs: Settle's lazy-mint arguments: the committed leaf preimage for the picked index and its proof.

types.name: RandLock
docs: Binds a Switchboard randomness account to one pending request so no other request can commit it
while this one is pending. PDA `["rand_lock", randomness]`.

types.name: Request
docs: One pending capture or re-roll. PDA `["request", vault, seq_le]`. Closed (rent to `user`) only
by settle, or by the principal-only expire after MAX_RECOMMITS unrevealed re-commits. There is
no cancel instruction and the fees are never refunded.

fields.name: seed_slot
docs: Switchboard seed slot of the vault's latest commit for this request.

fields.name: deadline_slot
docs: After this slot, if still unrevealed, anyone may re-commit (REVEAL_TIMEOUT_SLOTS).

fields.name: commits
docs: Number of commits so far (1 + re-commits), at most 1 + MAX_RECOMMITS.

fields.name: oracles
docs: Oracle of each commit; a re-commit must use an oracle not used before for this request.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Set by `reveal_randomness`: the value is recorded once and never changes (settle reads it).

fields.name: handed_in_index
docs: Asset index handed in for a re-roll, NO_HANDED_IN for a capture.

fields.name: mint_escrow_lamports
docs: Lazy-mint escrow amount deposited at request (ADR-016); the lamports sit in the separate
`["mint_escrow", vault, seq]` PDA, not in this account.

types.name: RevealArgs
docs: Reveal args (Switchboard `RandomnessRevealInstructionArgs`).

types.name: Vault
docs: One vault per hybrid_launch LaunchConfig. PDA `["vault", launch_config]`; every token account,
the collection and every asset are seeded by this vault key (never by an authority alone, A-06).
Economics (ratio, N, SOL fees, fee recipient) are READ from the immutable LaunchConfig on every
use (M-01); the vault keeps no copies. No instruction changes them.

fields.name: open
docs: Converting is closed until `open_vault` (graduation verified + collection fully minted). One-way.

fields.name: launch_config
docs: The immutable hybrid_launch LaunchConfig. Ratio, N, mint, SOL fees and fee recipient are READ
FROM IT on every use (audit M-01: no local copies).

fields.name: sb_queue
docs: Switchboard queue pinned at init; every randomness account must use it.

fields.name: trait_root
docs: Leaf-v2 Merkle root (merkle.rs) and the trait schema hash, committed at init.

fields.name: assets_outside
docs: NFTs owned by users (not in pool/incoming, not held as a re-roll hand-in).

fields.name: next_seq
docs: Next request sequence number / next request that may be settled or expired (FIFO head).

fields.name: total_fee_lamports
docs: Capture + re-roll SOL fees paid directly to the fee recipient.
